description.zh:
指定要解绑的API。

- 若不传入：默认解绑该分组该环境下的所有API。
- 若输入多个，“,”分隔，最多支持100个
description.en:
The IDs of the APIs from which you want to unbind a specified throttling policy.

- If this parameter is not specified, the throttling policy is unbound from all the APIs in the specified environment of the API group.

- Separate multiple API IDs with commas (,). A maximum of 100 API IDs can be entered.
The ID of the API group containing the APIs from which you want to unbind a specified throttling policy.

description.zh:
指定要操作API的环境。

- **RELEASE**: 线上
- **TEST**: 测试
description.en:
The name of the runtime environment. Valid values:

- **RELEASE**

- **TEST**

description.zh: 指定要操作的流控策略ID
description.en: The ID of the throttling policy that you want to unbind from APIs.

title.zh: 解除API与流控策略的绑定

descriptions.zh:
- 此功能面向开放API的用户
- 用于解除API与流控策略的绑定关系，支持API批量，最多100个
descriptions.en:
- This API is intended for API providers.

- This API allows you to unbind a specified throttling policy from up to 100 APIs at a time.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudapi remove-traffic-control-apis --traffic-control-id dd05f1c54d6749eda95f9fa6d491449a --group-id 0009db9c828549768a200320714b8930 --api-ids 3b81fd160f5645e097cc8855d75a1cf6,46fbb52840d146f186e38e8e70fc8c12 --stage-name TEST --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudapi RemoveTrafficControlApis --region cn-hangzhou --StageName TEST --ApiIds '3b81fd160f5645e097cc8855d75a1cf6,46fbb52840d146f186e38e8e70fc8c12' --TrafficControlId dd05f1c54d6749eda95f9fa6d491449a --GroupId 0009db9c828549768a200320714b8930
